summary: Iteration 55 - Trial System (15-day Free Trial) Testing. All 16 API tests PASSED (100%). Features tested: trial registration page, tenant creation with seeded data, duplicate email blocking, trial status endpoint, login with trial info, expired trial blocking (403), master admin without trial restrictions, seeded tickets access, and tenant data isolation.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/prueba-gratis returns HTML registration page with form fields (company_name, email, phone, password, country)
POST /api/trial/register creates tenant + admin user + seeded data (1 seller, 1 client, 3 demo tickets)
Duplicate email registration correctly returns 400 with 'email ya registrado' message
GET /api/trial/status returns is_trial=true, days_remaining=15, status='active' for trial users
POST /api/auth/login returns trial info (is_trial, days_remaining, trial_end) for trial users
Expired trial login correctly returns 403 with contact phone 718-916-1401
Expired trial API access correctly returns 403 with contact message
Master admin (admin@loteria.com) login works without trial restrictions
GET /api/trial/status returns is_trial=false, status='full' for master admin
Trial users see their seeded DEMO tickets with Vendedor Demo seller
Trial data is isolated by tenant_id - different trial users have different ticket numbers
seed_data_creation: Each trial registration creates: 1 tenant, 1 admin user, 1 demo seller, 1 demo client, 3 demo tickets with DEMO prefix
context_for_next_testing_agent: Trial system fully verified. Registration creates isolated tenant with seeded demo data. Expired trials are blocked at login (403) and API access (403) with contact phone 718-916-1401. Master admin has no trial restrictions (is_trial=false). Tickets API returns {tickets: [...]} format.
